description.value: Manufacturer's properties that describe the rudimentary data of the inlet connection.
Maximum backing pressure for which the conditions are defined in the instruction manual or in a specific standard for the particular vacuum pump.
Free cross-sectional area of the entry opening in the inlet connection of the pump.
Highest value of inlet pressure at which the pump or component is capable of functioning on the basis of the materials used.
The highest water vapor inlet pressure at which a gas ballast pump, under normal ambient conditions, can pump and exhaust pure water vapor in continuous Operation.
instantaneous inlet pressure with adequate margin above the minimum liquid vapor pressure expected.
Lowest value of inlet pressure at which the pump or component is capable of functioning on the basis of the materials used.
Total inlet pressure required to ensure there is enough margin to maintain the minimum.

Alphanumeric parameter for reference purposes, referring to a combination of mechanical and dimensional properties of a component of a piping system. It comprises the letters PN followed by a dimensionless number.
Mass of water which can be conveyed by the pump without condensation per time.
Properties that describe the specific installation and operational situation of the inlet connection.
Height of the center of the inlet connection of the pump
Rated flow at pump inlet connection divided by the inlet area of the pump

An alphanumeric designation of size for components of a pipework system, which is used for reference purposes. It comprises the letters DN followed by a dimensionless whole number which is indirectly related to the physical size, in millimeters, of the bore or outside diameter of the end connections.
Inlet pressure of the operating conditions at the guarantee point
Head observed at inlet area of the pump, corresponding to the sum of the height, pressure head and velocity head
All measurements of the operation which describe the inlet connection.
Measured temperature acting at the inlet area of the pump.
Quantity representing a temperature value
Measured rate of flow at pump inlet connection divided by the inlet area of the pump.
Vector quantity giving the rate of change of a position vector
Buyer's properties that describe the installation situation of the inlet port.
Pressure at the inlet of the pump, measured at a defined location in the test dome.
